title: DOCX Export Pipeline — nodeToDocx + Dialog + Multi-chapter
description: Build the DOCX export pipeline: create exportDocx.ts with nodeToDocx converter, extend export.ts with handlers for table/math/callout node types, extend ExportDialog with 'docx' format and 'current'/'project' scope selector, and wire multi-chapter export using projectSlice.
action: Create src/utils/exportDocx.ts with nodeToDocx() recursive converter using docx.js Paragraph/TextRun/HeadingLevel/TableRow/TableCell for existing node types plus table/math/callout. Modify src/utils/export.ts to add node type cases for table, math (inline + block), and callout in both nodeToMarkdown and nodeToHtml. Modify ExportDialog.tsx to add 'docx' to ExportFormat union, add scope selector ('current' | 'project'), and wire handleExport for docx format using generateDocx from exportDocx.ts. Implement multi-chapter export by iterating getChaptersForProject() and concatenating DOCX output.

steps: Create src/utils/exportDocx.ts — import { Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, HeadingLevel, TableRow, TableCell, WidthType, BorderStyle } from 'docx'. Export generateDocx(prosemirrorJSON, title) → Blob and generateProjectDocx(projectId, projectTitle) → Blob

Implement nodeToDocx(node) recursive converter with switch on node.type: doc→map children, paragraph→Paragraph, heading→Paragraph with HeadingLevel, text→TextRun with marks (bold/italic/underline/strike/code), bulletList/orderedList→Paragraph with bullet/number prefix, blockquote→Paragraph with indent, codeBlock→Paragraph with monospace font, horizontalRule→Paragraph with border, table→TableRow/TableCell grid, mathInline/mathBlock→TextRun with latex text, callout→Paragraph with background shading

Modify src/utils/export.ts — add table case to nodeToMarkdown (pipe-delimited rows) and nodeToHtml (<table>). Add mathInline case ($latex$), mathBlock case ($$latex$$), callout case (> [variant] content). Add import from exportDocx for generateDocx

Modify src/components/ExportDialog.tsx — extend ExportFormat type to include 'docx'. Add ExportScope type: 'current' | 'project'. Add scope radio group UI. Update handleExport to call generateDocx or generateProjectDocx based on scope

Wire multi-chapter export — in generateProjectDocx: call useAppStore.getState().getChaptersForProject(projectId), iterate chapters, read content via readChapterContent, convert each to DOCX sections, merge into single Document
Add downloadFile call for .docx extension with application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document MIME type

criteria: grep -r 'table\|mathInline\|mathBlock\|callout' src/utils/export.ts — new node type handlers in markdown/html converters
grep -r 'docx' src/components/ExportDialog.tsx — docx format option present
